intent: Every device has a PRESENCE — an always-on shim that answers what it is and how it is (never booted / running / offline-with-last-known), carries the four floor panes (status, settings, console, chat) and a declared verb set, and gives the same answers over the command line, the bus, and the web. Only the query processing belongs to the device itself.
why: Akien's own stated why, in his own words, about the embeddings generator echoing an embedding into its chat window: 'why the hell would anybody ever need that? Because then we can use it to prove to me it's working.' The chat window is the universal PROOF SURFACE — which is why it is FLOOR and not per-device, and why the useless-looking echo is the point rather than a feature request. A device you cannot address is a device you cannot check, and a fleet of thirteen you cannot check is a fleet you are trusting on narration (Law 3).
traces_to: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured — the chat window IS the measurement surface); Law 4 (presence carried by BaseShim is physics, presence each device remembers to implement is policy); Law 6 (the shim is the device's persistent front and process-manager — 'all of this is shim code stuff except the actual query processing' is an ownership ruling); Law 7 (never-booted and offline are loud honest answers; a silent nothing is the violation; a bounce rides a RECORD channel so it never collapses); Telos 2 (Cairn has a USER).
the_ruling_that_shaped_it: Akien, 2026-08-11: MURDERBOT. The pane set IS the channel set, projected — and this was already the bus's founding metaphor (cairn/bus/bus.py:24-29, the charter's `entry`, CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code/I-heartbeat-probes-and-bus.md:201-205, the Murderbot-feeds model, Martha Wells). announce = the PUBLIC feed (a builder announces completion publicly, not every step — the steps are in INFO); personal = the PERSONAL feed (Akien and CC chatting); info + debug = the CONSOLE pane, selected by buttons across the top with INFO the default (the stdout equivalent). Settings carries a circuit breaker. Public feed is a CHAT CHANNEL as well as an announce space — 'you me and igor can all chat about something', 'you me and hex via the librarian can talk over in the librarian's public chat about some bug he finds in himself'. And bounces are visible there: a bounce is something in the public feed, with its bounce message.
falsifier: DONE when, on the live roster: every device answers a presence query from all three faces (CLI, bus, web) with the same content; a never-booted device answers 'never booted' WITHOUT being booted by the asking; a downed device answers offline with a stamped last-known status; every device's page carries all four floor panes with an honest absent-with-reason wherever nothing stands behind one; the chat window takes at least the verbs its CLI takes; no envelope anywhere carries a channel outside the bus's four; and a message a shim cannot honestly hand to its device is returned to sender and READABLE IN THE SENDER'S PUBLIC FEED, with the trouble raised at the sender. Read from the instruments, never from narration. WRONG INTENT if presence goes green for a device with no process: BaseShim.running today means 'an object was constructed in this address space', and a health surface built on it reports healthy for a device that never ran — a green that means nothing is worse than the silence it replaces. ALSO WRONG INTENT if the bounce lane fills with troubles whose fixes all land at the receiver (the WATCHME's kill).
children_note: Children are named in the sorted berth with their full whys; they are filed as their own tickets as each is taken up (children prove before parents). REMAINING children come from examining the other devices — Akien: 'other kinds of devices will have to be examined to see what they do' — and are deliberately not guessed here. The embeddings generator echoing an embedding as a string is the named first case.

Its why ('every device answers am I running, and as what, the same way') is this node's child (b) exactly. Absorbed rather than worked in parallel: the pid becomes a field of the running state.
amends: mail-arrives-and-what-cannot-marks-itself :: child undeliverable-mail-raises-its-own-trouble — it says the BUS raises the trouble for mail it cannot hand over. Akien's ruling moves the raise to the SENDER, after a bounce posted to the sender's public feed. To be amended in place, not duplicated, or two tickets describe two mechanisms for one failure.

measured_at_cast.already_built: The chat pane RENDERS end to end (cairn/web_server/render.py:147-172, transcript + form), the librarian DECLARES it (cairn/librarian/trees.py:541-545), and a proof walks a POSTed utterance through the shim (proofs/test_web_server_chat.py). introspect() (cairn/base/device.py:82) and active_page() (cairn/base/shim.py:286) already give a floor-plus-declared-panes shape with ABSENT-WITH-REASON for an unwired pane — which is exactly the Scraps case (Akien's UU catch-all script device, given a chat window it could not honestly use, barking at anything that was not a slash command). bus.digest() already collapses a diagnostic channel to count+tail and REFUSES to collapse a record channel, which is the console pane's read arriving with its Law 7 tooth attached. This node is mostly COMPOSITION, not construction.
measured_at_cast.genuinely_absent: No pane kind 'console' exists anywhere in the tree. No shim spawns a process (no subprocess/Popen/fork). No verb set. No presence answer that works without waking the device. No CLI path to any device (bin/cairn dispatches to bin/cmd/<name> and there is no device fallback). The bus has no reply.
measured_at_cast.defects_found: (1) 'chat' is a channel that should never have existed, invented at TWO addresses — cairn/web_server/render.py:165 hardcodes it in the form's hidden field, cairn/librarian/trees.py:552 accepts only it — while the bus's falsifier reds on an unknown channel, so the one device with a real receive is structurally unreachable BECAUSE OF the invention. (2) The floor built at cairn/base/shim.py:309-311 is two panes; it should be four. (3) BaseShim.deliver calls _ensure_device() BEFORE it checks for a receive, so it WAKES a device in order to discover the device cannot help — the sleep/wake model violated at the exact seam that exists to honour it. Found against code written 2026-08-10.

open_at_cast: THE PROCESS MODEL — sequencing, so Akien's, asked twice and not yet answered. I-heartbeat-probes-and-bus.md:36 says each device is its own process and the shim is its process-manager; no shim spawns anything, so BaseShim.running reports 'an object was constructed in this address space'. Presence built on that is honest only if it says so. CC's lean: one device first as a proving ground — the librarian, the only one with a real device and a real receive — then the other twelve follow a proved pattern. This is the FIRST thing /chart must settle; the held ticket a-shim-status-pane-carries-a-pid records the same blocker from 2026-07-30.

watchme.trigger: Every clear of a bounce-raised trouble — the event that already fires, since the clear demands a what_changed. The probe reads bounce-raised troubles cleared AFTER THIS NODE'S PROVED CROSSING (the era floor) and classifies each what_changed by WHERE the fix landed: at the SENDER or at the RECEIVER. Fires when the receiver-side share exceeds half over at least 8 clears, or when a bounce-raised trouble stands live past 14 days with the same sender still sending.
watchme.enough: CLEARED once >= 8 post-era bounce-raised troubles have been cleared AND >= 6 were fixed at the SENDER. The kill is equally informative and retires it too: a receiver-side majority says the trouble is raised on the innocent party, which is a spec change, not a tuning. The era floor is load-bearing (the lesson of watchme-emits-a-probe): without it the corpus is the bounces CC causes and clears inside this very build. Akien may retire the watch by ruling.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against THIS ticket's falsifier, via cairn.chart.verdict.write_verdict — naming the post-era cleared count, the sender/receiver split with each deciding what_changed quoted, and any bounce-raised trouble whose prior_attempts shows a renegotiation that did not hold
watchme.consumer: AKIEN, through the owner's gate. The premise under test is his, in his own words, so a measured 'the fixes all landed at the receiver' is a spec-changing input, not a detail. The probe deposits and pokes; it has NO authority to back-edge this node (Law 6).
